[[File:Arbra_Airspeeder.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] skyspeeder over the surface of [[Arbra/Legends|Arbra]]]]
'''Skyspeeders''' were [[T-47 airspeeder/Legends|T-47 airspeeders]] adapted to serve in high-altitude environments. The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] expanded their program of adapting T-47s for specific environments after the success of the [[Snowspeeder/Legends|snowspeeder]]. Skyspeeders were modified with pressurized [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpits]] for high-altitude flight and were equipped with more power [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] [[Engine/Legends|engines]].<ref name="NEGVV">''[[The New Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>
